meta.title: 말랑베이커리
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (말랑베이커리, a neighbourhood bread delivery (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Plasticine pastels: a cream wall #FCE9D8 on a clay table #F2C9A0, golden crusts #D9954F to #B8732F, a pastel blue oven #9FD3E6, a coral scooter #F28B82, mint and soft roofs; chocolate brown #7A4A32 for type and faces.
rationale.type: Jua for every title, squashed letter by letter with a thick white edge and a soft drop; Dongle for small lines, set big since it runs small.
rationale.motion: Stop motion: the scenes step their time at 12 frames a second and every outline boils a little on each new frame; things hop in arcs, squash on landing and wobble back; loaves blink and bounce on the beat.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 112 BPM in F major (7 bars in 15 s, 14 in 30 s), marimba, pluck and bell on a full kit; organic SFX: bloops and pops for landings, a ding for the door.
rationale.visuals: All code: wobbly closed paths filled in clay (base, a highlight from the top left, a darker rim, speckle), soft contact shadows, loaves with faces, an oven, a scooter, houses, steam, a clay clock.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the pictures say it.
